name: sj-svalbard-coal-export-duty
description: Compute Svalbard coal-export duty for budget year 2026. Covers the exporter and producer liabilities, seasonal average FOB valuation, CIF freight and insurance adjustments, own-vessel bunker exclusion, cumulative tonnage bands, records, assessment, payment and appeal. Use for Svalbard coal duty, kullavgift, coal exports and shipping-season duty workpapers. Other minerals need their own charging decision. Reconciles the complete shipping season before applying the successive value-based bands, separates exporter and producer records, and checks shipment security against the actual requirement. Distinguishes the tax office assessment from the preparer's calculation and the appeal clock from the payment obligation. Flags the current filing format, annual coal-specific interest rate and quantities beyond the verified band schedule for confirmation before filing or payment.
